system.summary: A Dutch homophonic letter table accompanies an alphabetical codebook with fifteen marked number series and names.

diacritics.note: Fifteen blocks selected by overhead marks or struck digit; see NOTES.md.

system.notes: 1393 is the supplied review count of distinct transcribed dictionary codes, not the full historical codebook. Letter table 2–98; main blocks 99–999; names on key scans 59 and 78–82.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary decipherments on inv. 401 scans 28R, 42R–43R and 101R; no edition found in supplied prior-art work.

conditions.human_role: Decipherment by Feyseel Nur with Claude and Codex. Offline packaging of supplied evidence; original division of transcription work undocumented.

solution.what: Supplied research: De Leeuw 2000 describes Fagel codebooks, not Battier; no edition found; letters absent from DECODE.
Named Battier key NA 1.10.29 inv. 1209, DECODE R2794; old 5345 citation corrected.
Letter table and about 1400 codebook values transcribed; marked cipher tokens and inventory retained.
Key applied to four focus letters and supporting letters; roughly 55% of cipher in volume read.
Validation letters: 1113/1132 comparable tokens agree (98.3%); 94.7% key-alone.
Supplied 300-permutation control: 72% spelled runs segment into Dutch, mean 1.2%, maximum 4.1% shuffled. Not rerun during packaging.
Codex software re-decoding, not paleography: 19 Dec 186/186 and April 313/323 pass strict sense; Dec 1687 94.3% and Feb 1688 92.3% do not.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary key explicitly names Battier; NA 1.10.29 inv. 1209 / DECODE R2794 was applied to his correspondence.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Supplied volume estimate, about 55% of cipher in inv. 401; inventory in inv/orch_letters.tsv. Per-focus-letter strict measured results are in codex_review/metrics.tsv, not a volume-wide denominator.

gaps.detail: 12:6?0; getwist versus Turck(en); Novelli/Hofmeester; gesoubconneert gouverneren; Sex.; names, 81 and other repairs: codex_review/semantic_adjustments.tsv.

gaps.detail: Existing partial result packaged offline at user request; no claim that all possible research has been exhausted.

outcome.notes: Two focus letters pass strict sense: 186/186 and 313/323. Others 199/211 and 250/271 are below. No aggregate grade conversion or volume-wide coherent fraction is claimed. 81=e is contextual and absent from both validation letters.
